acceptance: tractable's release-gates.md says a consumer that vendors the wheel from the GitHub release may adopt it once the release exists and its SHA256SUMS verifies, while index installs wait for distribution-verify; the tractable PR is merged.
BenchBox docs/internal/comment-policy.md states the same rule next to the vendored-wheel provenance rules; the BenchBox PR is merged.
context: 2026-11-14 done. tractable half: https://github.com/joeharris76/tractable/pull/75 (merge 2ef7b7c) amends docs/operations/release-gates.md (After the tag, consumer rollout): a consumer that vendors the wheel from the GitHub release may adopt it once the release exists and its SHA256SUMS verifies; index installs, including the global tool, wait for distribution-verify. BenchBox half: https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4234 (merge 949f560, oracle SHIP, required checks green) states in docs/internal/comment-policy.md, with the vendored-wheel provenance rules, that a vendored tracker-runtime bump depends only on the GitHub release whose SHA256SUMS the ratchet verifies and does not wait for PyPI. description:
Process gap. tractable's docs/operations/release-gates.md says consumer rollout waits until the opt-in PyPI run's distribution-verify passes. BenchBox PR #4144 vendored tractable 1.1.1 and merged at 2026-11-12T04:46Z, about 8 hours before 1.1.1's PyPI publication completed (about 12:55Z, run 43133361734). No harm resulted: BenchBox vendors the GitHub release wheel, the comment-policy ratchet (scripts/check_comment_cleanup_scope.py, _verify_upstream_release) checks its hash against the release SHA256SUMS, and the pinned wheel (sha256 c09ba584...a5f4) is identical to the one PyPI serves.

Decision (owner, 2026-11-14): a vendored tracker-runtime bump depends only on the GitHub release whose SHA256SUMS the ratchet verifies; it does not wait for PyPI. Amend tractable's release-gates.md (consumer rollout) to distinguish vendored consumers from index-installed ones, and state the rule in BenchBox's docs/internal/comment-policy.md (vendored wheel section).

Guardrails:
- No change to the ratchet's checks.
- No new network dependency in BenchBox CI.
- The global index install on this machine still waits for distribution-verify.
